inlines.text: Find the equation of the circle with
Hint: Find the centre of the circle first.

answer.worked:
The centre is the midpoint of $AB$:
$$\begin{align*}C&=\left(\frac{-4+6}{2},\frac{5+(-3)}{2}\right)\\C&=(1,1).\end{align*}$$
Using the distance from the centre to $A$,
$$\begin{align*}r^2&=(-4-1)^2+(5-1)^2\\r^2&=25+16\\r^2&=41.\end{align*}$$
Therefore
$$(x-1)^2+(y-1)^2=41.$$
